title: Asset Library Contract
description: Describes how an enterprise asset library organizes components, templates, interactions, validation, indexes, and manifests for AI for Design workflows.

assetId.description: Unique identifier of one enterprise asset library, e.g. enterprise-dark or aurora-glass.

components.description: Glob pattern relative to asset library root for component source files.

templates.description: Glob pattern relative to asset library root for page template source files.

indexes.description: Directory that holds index JSON files, relative to asset library root.

manifest.description: Relative path to the asset manifest file.

components.description: Filename of the component index JSON under indexes/.

templates.description: Filename of the template index JSON under indexes/.

interactions.description: Optional filename of the interaction index JSON under indexes/.

rootKey.description: Root key inside the component index that holds the component map.

templateRootKey.description: Root key inside the template index that holds the template map.

interactionRootKey.description: Root key inside the interaction index that holds the interaction map.

configValidator.description: Optional relative path to a dependency-free library-specific configuration validator.

jsonFiles.description: JSON files or glob patterns whose assetVersion values must track the manifest version.

assetNaming.description: Rules for deriving asset IDs from source filenames.

prototypeBaseFilesField.description: Optional field listing base files copied for every prototype.

autoDetectDependencies.description: If true, attempt to parse import statements to populate dependencies.

ignorePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to ignore during scan.
